routes.when: Read, locate, count, measure, explain, or validate existing drawing content without changing it.
routes.rule: Use the narrowest evidence that answers the question. Partial results cannot certify the whole drawing.

routes.when: Create a new editable drawing from explicit requirements and host-selected units or knowledge.
routes.rule: Call one matching high-level compiler once. Do not decompose a supported engineering object into repeated primitive calls.

routes.when: Precisely change an existing drawing while preserving unrelated geometry and relationships.
routes.rule: Resolve exact IDs at the current revision and use one smallest matching proposal. Query topology before relationship-sensitive edits; query impact only before erase.
